FN-ZZJYKK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 125
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/17/2023
House Bill 125as introduced would make supplemental appropriations for the fiscal
year ending September 30, 2023 from the Veterans’ Assistance Fund to the Department of
Veterans’ Affairs in the amount of $10 million; and from the State General Fund a total amount
of $188,573,865 in the following amounts to the following entities:
(a) $5 million to the Department of Economic and Community Affairs for structural
repairs and maintenance at the Montgomery Surplus Warehouse;
(b) $1,935,000 to the Supreme Court for one-time repairs and maintenance of the
Heflin-Tolbert building;
(c) $39,911,517 to Debt Service, of which $485,556 is to be used for a required
payment for the General Obligation Bond Series 2022-A, and $39,425,961 to be used to satisfy
the remaining debt service for the General Obligation Bonds Series 2013A and 2013-B;
(d) $1,057,696 to the Department of Geological Survey, of which $57,696 is to be
used for the conversion of viewing rooms into office space, and $1 million is to be used to move
rock cores, samples, and other materials and equipment to the new Core and Sample Repository,
or expenses associated with ongoing capital projects;
(e) $1,052,652 to the Department of Senior Services for meals through the end of
the current emergency contract;
(f) $43 million to the Department of Mental Health, of which $23 million is to be
used for construction costs for Taylor Hardin; $10 million to be used to assist with the
reopening of Pickens County Hospital and renovating for psychiatric and child services; and $10
million to be used for the East Alabama Medical Center for psychiatric and child services;
Page 1

million to be used for the East Alabama Medical Center for psychiatric and child services;
FN-ZZJYKK-1
(g) $4.8 million to the Department of Forensic Sciences, of which $4 million is to be
used for lab equipment for the Huntsville laboratory; and $800,000 is to be used for equipment
for the new Dothan lab.
(h) $5,667,000 to the Military Department for the Huntsville Armory construction;
(i) $650,000 to the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles for moving expenses;
(j) $5.5 million to the Department of Corrections for the Offender Management
Program;
(k) $50 million to the General Fund Budget Reserve Fund;
(l) $8 million to the State Law Enforcement Agency for the Computerized Criminal
History (CCH) System;
(m) $8 million to the Department of Finance for elevator upgrades in the State
Capitol;
(n) $2 million to the Governor’s Mansion Authority for the roof and repairs at the
Hill house;
(o) $12 million to the Alabama Forestry Commission, of which $2 million is to be
used for replacement of firefighting equipment and aging equipment; $10 million is to be used
for grants to volunteer fire departments and rescue squads.
This bill would also appropriate such amounts as may be necessary for public funds
transferred into the State Treasury, in accordance with Executive Order number 726.
